answer: The strongest lever is simple: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because crystal only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
